project.title: Microeukaryotes in Changle river, Chengtan river, reservoir, influent, effluent, activated sludge, pig farm, soil, and sediment.
project.description: This project aims to investigate the composition and abundance of microeukaryotes in different habitats, in Zhejiang Province, southeast China.
project.center_name: National Research Centre (Egypt) & Institute of Urban Environment (China)
